Goal `core-time-duration-2-2`, stage 2 (the dossier). `Core\Time\Duration::parse`, `plus` and `seconds` are complete: `bun nv proofs --id` prints `complete.` for each, and their three figures are in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.
Six members still owe every proof: `toNanoseconds`, `toMicroseconds`, `toMilliseconds`, `toSeconds`, `toString` and `weeks`.
The Rust tests for this group live in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`'s test module, beside `duration_seconds_is_exact_and_bounded_on_both_sides`; `read_and_release` reads a returned `Duration`.
A literal argument to `Duration::parse` is folded at compile time, so every proof passes its text through a variable.
